title: fix(multiaxis): start and exit picks for the 5-axis parallel
body:
## What changes

Slice 3 of #3330: the 5-Axis Parallel (`Parallel5D`) takes a start point and an exit point. The kind now has the existing `PickCapability::Raster` ("the corner of the first raster row and the end of the last row").

A zigzag raster of fixed passes can start at four corners only: each end of the first pass and of the last pass. Each corner is one order of the same passes:
- reverse the pass order, or not;
- run every pass the other way, or not.

The zigzag alternation stays in all four orders. The new module `finishing3d::raster_seam` selects the order before the raster's link step (`raster_pass_seamed`). Then `multiaxis::parallel5d_seamed` poses the path with the same stamp.

- **Start:** the corner nearest the pick.
- **Exit alone:** the order whose last pass ends nearest the pick.
- **Start and exit:** of the orders whose start is in reach of the start pick, the order whose end is in reach of the exit pick. The smallest sum of the two distances wins. At a tie, the automatic order wins.
- A pick with a Z is read in 3D, to the tool tip. A pick without a Z is read in XY.
- The geometry of each pass does not change. The raster's own laws (`march::emit_runs`) plan the links between passes on the new order. The tilt limit, the shank dodge and the centre-cut guard read the path after the re-order.
- Cut direction: the raster cuts both ways by its zigzag law and does not read `climb`. Parallel5D has no one-way mode. Thus no order asks for a direction that the operation forbids. The waterline rings after the raster keep their climb order.
- No pick: the passes stay as they are. The path is byte-identical.

The decision, with the dropped options, is in `docs/decisions/3330-parallel5d-picks.md`.

## Refusals (by name, never moved)

- A pick farther than 1.5 tool diameters from every corner of its role: `start point (x, y): the raster can start only at a corner (an end of its first or its last pass); the nearest corner (...) stands d mm away, farther than ...`. The exit pick has the same text.
- An exit that no order from the start pick can end at: `exit point (...): a raster that starts at the start point ends at (...) - farther than ... from the exit point; ...`.
- A pick on a raster with no pass (no shallow ground in the depths).
- A seam on a pattern other than the one-direction Parallel raster. Only Parallel5D reads a seam.

**Plunge and retract columns: there is no new refusal, on purpose.** Each corner is a raster sample. The raster keeps a sample only where the ball's vertical column up to the clearance plane is clear (`support::plunge_support`). With shank avoidance, the stamp checks the shank at each cut station with a column that is open upward (`avoid::shank_hits`). Thus the plunge station and the last cut station already prove the shank column. A new column check could not fire, and no mutation of it could turn a test red. The pins hold the law that the pick depends on instead (see M5 below).

## Mutation table

Each mutation was applied by itself to head `9af967e38`. Then `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test multiaxis raster_seam` ran on winbuild, and the change was reverted. M6 ran again on `b9101ecb1`, after a fix to the pin.

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | The start reach check removed (`retain` with `f64::INFINITY`) | RED: `raster_impossible_picks_are_refused_by_name`, `raster_picked_columns_under_a_canopy_stay_clear_or_are_refused_by_name` |
| M2 | The exit consistency check removed (exit filtered only without a start) | RED: `raster_impossible_picks_are_refused_by_name` |
| M3 | Order ignored (always the automatic order) | RED: `raster_start_point_...`, `raster_exit_point_...`, `raster_picked_columns_...` |
| M4 | Flip dropped (pass order only) | RED: `raster_start_point_...`, `raster_exit_point_...` |
| M5 | The raster column trim disabled (`plunge_support` keeps samples under a canopy) | RED: `raster_picked_columns_under_a_canopy_stay_clear_or_are_refused_by_name` (the 0.25 mm ball sweep over the chosen corner hits the canopy) |
| M6 | An empty seam reverses the passes | RED: `raster_without_a_pick_is_the_automatic_path_byte_for_byte`, `raster_start_point_...` |

In the first M6 run, the byte-identity pin stayed green. Both sides of that pin go through the seamed code, so the pin compared the code with itself. The pin now also asserts the automatic start corner by itself: ball centre (40, 1, 3). M6 now turns it red.

## Readings

- The automatic raster on the 40 x 30 floor with a block starts at ball centre (40, 1, 3). Its first row runs toward -X: a rim row takes the parity of its neighbour.
- Canopy fixture: a plate that leans 50 degrees over the (0, 0) corner, z 10 to 20. A pick at (0, 0) is refused, because the nearest corner is farther than 9 mm. A pick at (6, 0) starts or ends at a corner with x > 6, and its column sweep is clear.

## Pinning tests

`camcraft-motion`, suite `multiaxis` (new module `multiaxis/raster_seam.rs`):
- `raster_without_a_pick_is_the_automatic_path_byte_for_byte`
- `raster_start_point_starts_the_cut_at_the_nearest_corner` (the far end of the first pass: each pass runs the other way; the automatic end: the whole raster runs back)
- `raster_exit_point_ends_the_last_pass_at_the_nearest_corner` (the last cut ends at the corner, and the tool rises straight up)
- `raster_impossible_picks_are_refused_by_name`
- `raster_picked_columns_under_a_canopy_stay_clear_or_are_refused_by_name`

Each picked path is sampled every 0.25 mm along each move:
- every move: the ball sinks no more than the tolerance into a facet (no gouge, no link through a wall);
- every raster cut lies on a cut of the automatic raster (the geometry does not change, and the count of cuts is the same).

`camcraft-app`, suite `start_exit_shared` (new module `start_exit_shared/parallel5d.rs`, and one arm in the capability test):
- `parallel5d_starts_at_the_picked_corner_and_ends_at_the_picked_exit` (through `operation::generate`; cuts sampled every 0.25 mm against the automatic raster; no pick gives the same path)
- `parallel5d_refuses_an_impossible_pick_by_name`
- `parallel5d_picks_ride_edit_operation_and_undo_restores_them` (MCP `edit_operation`, `undo`, `redo`; the `edit_operation` schema names the raster kind)
- `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` (Parallel5D is `Raster`)

## Goldens

No golden moved. The example catalog suites ran in the quick gate (see below).

## Windows gate (winbuild)

Log `C:\camcraft-logs\gate-3330c-3835572b7c1f9cc1c3040279fc422af40b22b224.log`. Its first line is the head SHA `3835572b7`. This head is the branch after `git merge origin/main` (`034e91b8b`). The merge base is `034e91b8b`. The merge had one conflict, in the `s_edit_op` text of `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`: main added the sinker and hole-order words, and this PR added the raster clause. Both are kept.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=5`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_STALL_MIN=45`) | 237 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (61.9 min). This includes the 36 motion suites (`multiaxis`, `finish3d*`, `pivot5d`, ...), `example_catalog` / `_adaptive` / `_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, `first_part_programs`, `mcp_doc_drift` and `start_exit_shared` |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Earlier attempts:
- Attempt 1 on `b9101ecb1`: the `app build (--no-run)` step stalled. The watchdog stopped it after 15 minutes with no output, while link.exe was still alive. Clippy found one `ptr_arg` error, fixed in `59a326e83`.
- Attempt 2 on `59a326e83`: all green (237 / 6 / clean). Then `main` moved and gave the conflict above.

The stall watchdog was set to 45 minutes for the next attempts, because winbuild needs more than 15 minutes to link the 237 app test binaries with 5 jobs.

No heavy step: this PR is P2 ("Heavy lanes at review").

## Not exercised

- No UI rows for the picks on the operation page. As in slices 1 and 2, the picks ride `edit_operation` and the viewport pick. The page no longer shows "not taken" for this kind.
- A tilted (3+2) setup frame: the picks are read in the generator's frame, as in slices 1 and 2.
- Shank avoidance in the motion pins. The column law for the shank is read from the code (`avoid::shank_hits`), and no pin turns it on.
- No Mac build. The builds and tests ran on winbuild only.

## Files

- `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/raster.rs` is now 406 lines. It was 410 lines on main. The seam hook adds lines, and `shallow_footprint` moved to `polar.rs` (369 lines), its only user. All new files are below 400 lines. No new test binary: the tests join the `multiaxis` and `start_exit_shared` suites.
- The merge of PR #4050 with this PR gives small conflicts in `pick_kinds.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs` and the `s_edit_op` text in `mcp/tools.rs`. On each side, only the arm of its own kind changes.

## Remaining kinds of #3330

Swarf, AdvancedSwarf, RotaryContour, RotaryParallel (it can use `raster_seam::order` again), RotaryOffset, MultiAxisRough, Flow5D. MultiAxisContour is in open PR #4050.

Changelog: The 5-Axis Parallel takes a start point and an exit point: the cut starts at the raster corner nearest the start point, and the last pass ends at the corner nearest the exit point. A pick that no corner is near is refused by name.
